tier.description: The agent's model size when no role sets one

tiers.description: Also render the agent once per tier as <name>-<tier>

grants.description: <system>:<level> grants, mapped to harness tools by the adapter

effort.description: How hard the model reasons (tier picks the model). Resolved per task: task new --effort > mode > role > agent > defaults.effort; risk high/low then moves it one level, clamped by effort.min/max

dispatch.description: How the CoS runs the subagent: background (start it, return to the PM, report when it lands) or foreground (wait). Resolved like effort: task new --dispatch > mode > role > agent > defaults.dispatch
